description: Preregistered correction contract for LONG-002E1 Round-1 Candidate-System Search correcting evaluation period alignment, fold definitions, outcome join integrity, execution provenance, and calibration labeling.
superseded_reason: Fold-1 design asymmetry left fitted families unpredicted in 2017 due to post-purge 2016 training set having zero rows; models evaluated on non-common periods (2017-2020 vs 2018-2020) and non-common baselines; outcome matrix positional merge; unverified execution provenance; mislabeled calibration status.

expanding_folds.description: Fold A: train on retained 2016-2017, evaluate on 2018
Fold B: train on retained 2016-2018, evaluate on 2019
Fold C: train on retained 2016-2019, evaluate on 2020

round2_eligible.annual_positive_years_description: Exactly 3 of 3 OOF evaluation years (2018, 2019, 2020) must have positive Precision@10 delta vs matched VAM5, derived mechanically as ceil(0.75 * 3) = 3

round1_not_supported.condition: Either 21-session bootstrap 97.5th percentile Precision@10 delta <= 0, OR (pooled Precision@10 delta <= 0 AND positive annual years <= 1 of 3)
